title: MR 33.1.3 (version taken from documentation.meraki.com release-notes links)

announcements.post_subject: A new Beta MR Wireless firmware is now available

Fixed issues: Non-802.11be clients may lose traffic after roaming between radios on the same AP | MR-97296 | CW9178I | R33.1: 33.1.1, 33.1.2
CW9172H port-profile changes may power off unchanged LAN ports | MR-96863 | CW9172H | R32.1: 32.1.7; R32.2: 32.2.4; R33.1: 33.1.2
Band Steering may continue after it is disabled | MR-96585 | CW9176I | R32.1: 32.1.7; R32.2: 32.2.4
Static IPv4 clients with ongoing IPv6 activity may become unreachable over IPv4 | MR-94296 | All APs | R32.1: 32.1.6, 32.1.7; R33.1: 33.1.1
Tunneled wireless client traffic may leak onto the AP uplink during disconnect | MR-93629 | CW9178I | R32.2: 32.2.3
Wi-Fi 7 APs may send QoS data frames towards the end client STA with To DS bit 1, and From DS bit 1 | MR-93209 | CW9172I, CW9176I | R31.1: 31.1.8; R32.1: 32.1.6; R32.2: 32.2.3
Air Marshal may stop containing blocked SSIDs after they move from DFS to non-DFS channels | MR-92907 | All APs | R32.1: 32.1.7
Large Adaptive Policy configurations may not be applied | MR-78486 | All APs | R31.1: 31.1.7.1; R32.1: 32.1.4 to 32.1.7; R32.2: 32.2.1 to 32.2.4
Wi-Fi 7 APs may unexpectedly reboot during normal operation | MR-97489 | CW9171I, CW9172H, CW9172I | R32.1: 32.1.7; R32.2: 32.2.4; R33.1: 33.1.1, 33.1.2
CW9164I APs may repeatedly reboot with mixed 6 GHz security modes | MR-97659 | CW9164I | R33.1: 33.1.1, 33.1.2
Known issues: MR36 uplink may remain unavailable after an ungraceful power cycle | MR-96919 | MR36 | R32.1: 32.1.4 to 32.1.7; R32.2: 32.2.1 to 32.2.4; R33.1: 33.1.1 to 33.1.3
CW9166I APs may stop transmitting 5 GHz or 6 GHz beacon frames | MR-97710 | CW9166I | R32.1: 32.1.6, 32.1.7; R32.2: 32.2.4; R33.1: 33.1.1 to 33.1.3
CW9163E may repeatedly reboot in site survey mode in the UK regulatory domain | MR-97525 | CW9163E | R32.1: 32.1.7; R32.2: 32.2.4; R33.1: 33.1.1 to 33.1.3
